subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw officially support Azure Foundry/Azure OpenAI Realtime Talk through the bundled OpenAI gateway relay now with a validated server-side API-key path, while deferring Entra or managed-identity support?
rationale: Current main has Azure bridge mechanics but no documented and live-proven Talk contract; the choice determines supported auth modes, diagnostics, and whether the existing bridge is an internal capability or a public provider promise.

options.title: Sponsor API-key relay support
options.body: Define and validate one Azure Foundry gateway-relay configuration that keeps an API key in the Gateway, then add tests, docs, and live smoke proof before public support is claimed.

options.title: Defer until Entra design is ready
options.body: Keep Azure relay behavior undocumented for Talk until the project can support the desired identity and SecretRef contract together.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Document the existing bridge only as unsupported experimental behavior while collecting live Azure compatibility evidence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor API-key relay support
recommendation.body: Define and validate one Azure Foundry gateway-relay configuration that keeps an API key in the Gateway, then add tests, docs, and live smoke proof before public support is claimed.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the maintainer Azure availability assessment in the discussion and have recent history in the realtime provider surface.
